events.title: Image Uploading and Embedding
events.description: Omniscient released a new feature for adding images to posts/threads, hosted on a site he owns and supporting encryption. Currently in beta — built in collaboration with Vinavil, who had been developing an image-encrypting project.

events.title: Draw A Winner Thread
events.description: Charlie Sheen opened a thread giveaway hosts can use to have a staff member randomly pick a winner — supporting the recent monetary-contest rule changes and helping combat scam giveaways.

events.title: Awards
events.description: King Decade awarded to RonzaX and Tonka. Businessman awarded to Wilmer. Green Apple awarded to goldwhite.

events.description: newQuery and Hackers were added as leaders of Vibe.

events.title: Movie of the Week — The Green Mile (1999)
events.description: The Pact submitted The Green Mile, recalling watching it on first release in 1999 and praising the film's emotional richness and moral complexity.
